description: Probes any HTTP(S) URL once, right now, from Cloudflare's edge and reports httpStatus, edgeLatencyMs and meetsSla (true when the status is 2xx/3xx within maxLatencyMs, or when an x402 API answers 402 with a valid payment request, whose offer is then reported; an endpoint that answers GET with 405 is retried as a JSON-RPC POST). Use it before calling or paying an unfamiliar endpoint. Free and unsigned, up to 10 checks per month per IP (access shows what's left); a walletAddress with an active pass removes the limit. Sends one request to the target. For a result a third party can verify, use verify_endpoint_sla instead. The result includes a SHA-256 probeHash (a content hash, not a signature).

endpointUrl.description: Full http(s) URL to probe, e.g. "https://api.example.com/health".

maxLatencyMs.description: Latency limit in milliseconds for meetsSla.

walletAddress.description: Optional Base wallet holding an active 7-day pass: removes the monthly free-check limit (with walletSignedAt + walletSignature).

walletSignature.description: personal_sign by walletAddress of "AgentSLA pass access\nWallet: <checksummed walletAddress>\nSigned at: <walletSignedAt>". Proves you control the pass wallet; no gas.

walletSignedAt.description: Unix seconds when walletSignature was made (within the last 5 minutes).
